text: 我改变主意了。没有什么问题了。
source_text: 我改变主意了。没有什么问题了。

text: What you say if I told you I'm from a Vault?
source_text: What you say if I told you I'm from a Vault?

text: 如果我告诉你，我从一个避难所来，你会说什么呢？
source_text: 如果我告诉你，我从一个避难所来，你会说什么呢？

text: Our plans?  We are the messengers of evolution, my child. We follow the Master in his endless quest to heal the land and the people.
source_text: Our plans?  We are the messengers of evolution, my child. We follow the Master in his endless quest to heal the land and the people.

text: 我们的计划？我们是进化的使者，我的孩子。我们追随主教的无尽的使命，恢复这片土地和人们。
source_text: 我们的计划？我们是进化的使者，我的孩子。我们追随主教的无尽的使命，恢复这片土地和人们。

text: Really? Just what kind of evolution are you teaching?
source_text: Really? Just what kind of evolution are you teaching?

text: 真的？那你宣讲的进化是怎么回事？
source_text: 真的？那你宣讲的进化是怎么回事？

text: What kind of healing?
source_text: What kind of healing?

text: 什么样的恢复？
source_text: 什么样的恢复？

text: We know there is a higher level, a glorious place humanity should strive to reach.  Ours is the goal to find the life better, more fulfilling, than the present one, marred by hardship and strife.
source_text: We know there is a higher level, a glorious place humanity should strive to reach.  Ours is the goal to find the life better, more fulfilling, than the present one, marred by hardship and strife.

text: 我知道人类应该努力发展到一个更高的境界和更荣耀的地位。我们的目标是寻求更好的生活，相比现在被苦难和冲突损害的生活更值得为之奋斗。
source_text: 我知道人类应该努力发展到一个更高的境界和更荣耀的地位。我们的目标是寻求更好的生活，相比现在被苦难和冲突损害的生活更值得为之奋斗。

text: You're kidding, right?
source_text: You're kidding, right?

text: 你在说笑，对吗？
source_text: 你在说笑，对吗？

text: And have you found this higher level ?
source_text: And have you found this higher level ?

text: 你找到了这个更高的境界吗？
source_text: 你找到了这个更高的境界吗？

text: 【Angry】Why you!...【Calmly】You are forgiven. Not everyone is capable of seeing the light. But, tell me my child, why did you join us?
source_text: 【Angry】Why you!...【Calmly】You are forgiven. Not everyone is capable of seeing the light. But, tell me my child, why did you join us?

text: 【生气】你竟然……！【冷静下来】我可以宽恕你，不是每个人都有能力见到光明。但是，我的孩子，你告诉我，你为什么加入我们？
source_text: 【生气】你竟然……！【冷静下来】我可以宽恕你，不是每个人都有能力见到光明。但是，我的孩子，你告诉我，你为什么加入我们？

text: I had to see if this was as much of a joke as I'd heard. Now I know.
source_text: I had to see if this was as much of a joke as I'd heard. Now I know.

text: 我要看这是否跟我听过的笑话差不多。现在我知道了。
source_text: 我要看这是否跟我听过的笑话差不多。现在我知道了。

text: Sorry. I guess I was out of line.
source_text: Sorry. I guess I was out of line.

text: 抱歉。我想是我的觉悟还不够。
source_text: 抱歉。我想是我的觉悟还不够。

text: You know nothing.
source_text: You know nothing.

text: 你完全不了解。
source_text: 你完全不了解。

text: Yes, you were, but you are forgiven.  Now, if there are no more questions, I have work to do.
source_text: Yes, you were, but you are forgiven.  Now, if there are no more questions, I have work to do.

text: 是的，你是的，但你被宽恕了。现在，如果没有别的问题，我有事要忙。
source_text: 是的，你是的，但你被宽恕了。现在，如果没有别的问题，我有事要忙。

text: Actually, there are some more.
source_text: Actually, there are some more.

text: 事实上，我还有些问题。
source_text: 事实上，我还有些问题。

text: Nope, thanks.
source_text: Nope, thanks.

text: 不，谢谢。
source_text: 不，谢谢。

text: Of course. Please.  Continue.
source_text: Of course. Please.  Continue.

text: 当然。请。继续吧。
source_text: 当然。请。继续吧。

text: Yes, but you are...forgiven.  Go in peace, my child.
source_text: Yes, but you are...forgiven.  Go in peace, my child.

text: 是的，不过你……已经被宽恕了。你安心去吧，我的孩子。
source_text: 是的，不过你……已经被宽恕了。你安心去吧，我的孩子。

text: No, but with faith and hope, we're certain to find it. But all this should be known to you, my child.
source_text: No, but with faith and hope, we're certain to find it. But all this should be known to you, my child.

text: 不，但是由于信仰和希望，我们必定会找到它。这一切你应该了解的，我的孩子。
source_text: 不，但是由于信仰和希望，我们必定会找到它。这一切你应该了解的，我的孩子。

text: I know, but just a few more questions, please.
source_text: I know, but just a few more questions, please.

text: 我了解，只不过还要请问几个问题。
source_text: 我了解，只不过还要请问几个问题。

text: I know. Goodbye.
source_text: I know. Goodbye.

text: 我了解。再见。
source_text: 我了解。再见。

text: We cure the physical body to start.  You've certainly seen our hospitals.  Then we offer hope and healing for the spirit.
source_text: We cure the physical body to start.  You've certainly seen our hospitals.  Then we offer hope and healing for the spirit.

text: 我们从医治人们物质上的身体开始。你当然见过我们的医院。然后，我们提供精神上的希望和医治。
source_text: 我们从医治人们物质上的身体开始。你当然见过我们的医院。然后，我们提供精神上的希望和医治。

text: Wow. I almost believed that. You're good!
source_text: Wow. I almost believed that. You're good!

text: 哇。我几乎相信那些了。你们是好心的！
source_text: 哇。我几乎相信那些了。你们是好心的！

text: Where are these hospitals?
source_text: Where are these hospitals?

text: 这些医院在哪里呢？
source_text: 这些医院在哪里呢？

text: Our glorious effort has just reached Adytum and, of course, the Hub shines with our efforts there.  But, I have a feeling there's more you wish to ask.
source_text: Our glorious effort has just reached Adytum and, of course, the Hub shines with our efforts there.  But, I have a feeling there's more you wish to ask.

text: 我们光荣的努力刚到达内城区，当然，哈勃城那里也因我们的努力生气勃勃。但是，我有种感觉，你有更多的事情想问。
source_text: 我们光荣的努力刚到达内城区，当然，哈勃城那里也因我们的努力生气勃勃。但是，我有种感觉，你有更多的事情想问。

text: These are wondrous days.  Junktown now joins in Adytum and the Hub in our quest to save body and soul.  Is there more you wish to know, my child?
source_text: These are wondrous days.  Junktown now joins in Adytum and the Hub in our quest to save body and soul.  Is there more you wish to know, my child?

text: 这些都是不平凡的日子。迦克镇现在加入内城区和哈勃城的行列，都在我们履行拯救肉体和灵魂的使命中，你还想知道更多吗，我的孩子？
source_text: 这些都是不平凡的日子。迦克镇现在加入内城区和哈勃城的行列，都在我们履行拯救肉体和灵魂的使命中，你还想知道更多吗，我的孩子？

text: As a matter of fact . . .
source_text: As a matter of fact . . .

text: 事实上……
source_text: 事实上……

text: Nothing. I gotta go.
source_text: Nothing. I gotta go.

text: 没什么。我要走了。
source_text: 没什么。我要走了。

text: The Children's vision now stretches from Adytum, to the Hub, Junktown, and now gently caresses Shady Sands.  Why do you ask?
source_text: The Children's vision now stretches from Adytum, to the Hub, Junktown, and now gently caresses Shady Sands.  Why do you ask?

text: 大教堂的目光现在从内城区延伸，投向哈勃城，迦克镇，现在正轻抚着沙荫镇。你为什么要问这个？
source_text: 大教堂的目光现在从内城区延伸，投向哈勃城，迦克镇，现在正轻抚着沙荫镇。你为什么要问这个？

text: Just wondering. Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: Just wondering. Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: 只是觉得奇怪。我能多问你几个问题吗？
source_text: 只是觉得奇怪。我能多问你几个问题吗？

text: Nothing. I gotta go.
source_text: Nothing. I gotta go.

text: 没什么。我要走了。
source_text: 没什么。我要走了。

text: You are what?
source_text: You are what?

text: 你怎么了？
source_text: 你怎么了？

text: You heard me. Take me to see the Master, now!
source_text: You heard me. Take me to see the Master, now!

text: 你听见我的话吗。带我去见主教，马上！
source_text: 你听见我的话吗。带我去见主教，马上！

text: Uh, yes. Well.  Please follow me.
source_text: Uh, yes. Well.  Please follow me.

text: 哦，好的。嗯。请跟我来。
source_text: 哦，好的。嗯。请跟我来。

text: Oh, my child, you make no sense whatsoever.  please, find one of our physicians and get help.
source_text: Oh, my child, you make no sense whatsoever.  please, find one of our physicians and get help.

text: 哦，我的孩子，你真是词不达意呢。去吧，找我们的治疗师寻求帮助。
source_text: 哦，我的孩子，你真是词不达意呢。去吧，找我们的治疗师寻求帮助。

text: My child, talk to Lasher.  He'll help you with that.
source_text: My child, talk to Lasher.  He'll help you with that.

text: 我的孩子，你去跟拉舍尔谈谈吧。他会帮助你。
source_text: 我的孩子，你去跟拉舍尔谈谈吧。他会帮助你。

text: I said...
source_text: I said...

text: I will not say it again!
source_text: I will not say it again!

text: 我不会再说一次！
source_text: 我不会再说一次！

text: The Nightkin came to us a while ago.  They might be hideous mutants but they are extremely loyal to the Children.  As we all are.
source_text: The Nightkin came to us a while ago.  They might be hideous mutants but they are extremely loyal to the Children.  As we all are.

text: 夜之团刚到我们这里来服役。他们或许是丑恶的变种人，但他们对大教堂是非常忠诚的。象我们大家一样。
source_text: 夜之团刚到我们这里来服役。他们或许是丑恶的变种人，但他们对大教堂是非常忠诚的。象我们大家一样。

source_text: It is he who brought me the vision of the Unity and it is he who will bring peace to this troubled land.

text: 是他让我看到统一的前景，是他将把和平带给这片不平静的土地。
source_text: 是他让我看到统一的前景，是他将把和平带给这片不平静的土地。

source_text:
My child, you should know the Auditorium.  I give my sermons

source_text: 我的孩子，你应该知道那个礼堂。我在那里宣讲教义。

source_text: Don't concern yourself with that.  Only the High Priests may enter.

text: 这不关你的事。只有高级牧师可以进入。
source_text: 这不关你的事。只有高级牧师可以进入。

text: I am but a humble servant of the Unity.
source_text: I am but a humble servant of the Unity.

text: 我只是为“同一”服务的一个低下仆人。
source_text: 我只是为“同一”服务的一个低下仆人。

source_text: We are the high priests of the great Dark God. Thirteen of us are so blessed to pass his mighty words to the rest of the Children.

source_text: 我们是伟大黑暗之神的高级牧师。我们十三人受到这样的祝福，传达他的强大命令给大教堂的其他人。

source_text: I've no idea what you're talking about.

text: 我不懂你在说些什么。
source_text: 我不懂你在说些什么。

text: The Children of the Cathedral hospitals provide the best care in all of this blasted, torn land. This care is vital to the Unity.
source_text: The Children of the Cathedral hospitals provide the best care in all of this blasted, torn land. This care is vital to the Unity.

source_text: 大教堂的医院给所有这些被诅咒的、破碎的土地提供最好的照顾。这种照顾对于“同一”是至关重要的。

text: The Unity is our search for a higher level of life, and unity with our fellow man.
source_text: The Unity is our search for a higher level of life, and unity with our fellow man.
